2607.21067.title: PrefReward: Learning User Preference Matrix for Personalized Text Generation
2607.21067.paper_summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated remarkable ability in generating personalized content by leveraging user histories and contextual cues. However, most existing personalization approaches rely on implicit representations within model parameters, making it difficult to interpret user-specific preferences or effectively handle long-context dependencies. To address these challenges, we propose PrefReward, a novel preference-aware generative framework that explicitly models user styles through a structured preference matrix and integrates it into the decoding process as a reward signal. PrefReward consists of two stages: (1) extracting a user-specific preference matrix that summarizes individual stylistic tendencies, and (2) using the matrix to guide generation via a KL-divergence-based reward function. Experiments on the LongLaMP dataset show that PrefReward outperforms non-personalized and retrieval-based baselines in both generation quality and personalization interpretability.
2607.21067.paper_summary_zh: 大型語言模型（LLMs）在利用用戶歷史和上下文線索生成個性化內容方面展現了卓越的能力。<lb/>然而，大多數現有的個性化方法依賴於模型參數中的隱式表示，這使得解釋用戶特定偏好或有效處理長上下文依賴變得困難。<lb/>為了解決這些挑戰，我們提出了PrefReward，一種新穎的偏好感知生成框架，通過結構化的偏好矩陣明確建模用戶風格，並將其作為獎勵信號整合到解碼過程中。<lb/>PrefReward由兩個階段組成：（1）提取一個用戶特定的偏好矩陣，以總結個體的風格傾向；（2）使用該矩陣通過基於KL散度的獎勵函數指導生成。<lb/>在LongLaMP數據集上的實驗顯示，PrefReward在生成質量和個性化可解釋性方面均優於非個性化和基於檢索的基準。
